title: API error v1
description: Safe server error envelope. HTTP/code pairs: 400 INVALID_REQUEST, 401 UNAUTHENTICATED, 404 CASE_NOT_FOUND, PROGRAM_NOT_FOUND, FORM_NOT_AVAILABLE or NOT_FOUND (unknown endpoint), 409 CASE_REVISION_MISMATCH, PACKET_GENERATION_CONFLICT, FORM_CONTEXT_MISMATCH, FORM_ANSWERS_CONFLICT or FORM_ANSWERS_STALE, 413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, 415 UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE, 405 METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR, 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE. Clients display their own safe messages, not raw server details.
